title: Stir-Fried Beef and Celery
description: A quick and savory dish featuring thinly sliced beef and crunchy celery, all stir-fried to perfection.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Add the sliced beef and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced celery and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet.
Add the umami-rich soy sauce, chewy ramen noodles, and Japanese chili flakes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
